A '''grenade launcher''' was a portable weapon used to shoot [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] over longer distances than they could normally be thrown.

==Description==
Grenade launchers were military weapons that greatly improved the range of grenades. Grenades fired by grenade launchers always exploded on impact, regardless of timers. Grenade launchers were generally not able to hurl [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] because these devices were too big and heavy, however some launchers such as the [[Thermal Detonator Launcher]] were specially made to fire these powerful explosives. Grenade launchers could also be mounted on a rifle, creating a dual-purpose weapon.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> The [[Under-barrel grenade launcher]] was one example of this.
[[File:DC_Grenade_Attachment.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An under-barrel grenade launcher used by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]]]]

The main variants of grenade launchers were the [[Micro-grenade launcher/Legends|Micro-Grenade Launcher]] which fired smaller grenades and the [[Grenade mortar]] which lobbed grenades over distances longer than a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]. Other variant models of grenade launchers included the [[RD-4 grenade launcher]], the [[TTT-54 "Thumper"]], the [[HH-4 grenade launcher]], the [[Concussion grenade launcher/Legends|Concussion grenade launcher]], and the [[Electromagnetic pulse launcher|EMP Launcher]].

Grenade launchers were also attached to a number of vehicles. Examples of vehicles with grenade launchers include the [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut|A5 Juggernaut]], the [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 landspeeder]],<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transport]],<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" /> and the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Mobile grenade mortar|Merr-Sonn Mobile Grenade Mortar]] was the vehicle form of a grenade launcher. The Grenade Mortar could fire up to one hundred grenades per second. The Empire also sometimes equipped grenade launchers on a [[Mobile Defense Unit]]. Grenade launchers could also be mounted to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], making it possible for some ships to fire concussion grenades. By adding these launchers, a starfighters overall effectiveness could be greatly raised.

==History==
[[Mandalorian Supercommando]]s were known to use underslung grenade launchers attached to their [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Clone jet troopers]] would use grenade launchers loaded with [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]] which were effective against droid adversaries.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> During the [[Rebellion era]], [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Spacetroopers]] would use grenade launchers with a variety of grenades during their boarding missions.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />
